system.summary: Undivided runs of figures inside clear German letters; about 137 figures for 20 words on 964 f. 6, so a syllable or word code of the Hanoverian chancery.
system.notes: Group boundaries not marked; no code table built.

prior_solution.where: interlinear decipherments on the cipher pages themselves

conditions.human_role: Posed the problem by pasting the catalogue 598 brief; no target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Archivportal-D blocked by a bot check; Arcinsys ids from the DDB Solr index, METS and the fixed image URL pattern from the in-app browser; page counts of all ten files from thumbnails.
Paged through Nr. 97 (all), 964 (all), 379, 563 and 1130 (images 5-8): every cipher run seen carries an interlinear decipherment; outgoing drafts are clear with the enciphered passages underlined.
Nr. 964 f. 6 (rescript 6/17 Dec 1734): figures, interlinear decipherment and clear text transcribed line by line (texts/964_f6.txt); reading written (texts/964_f6_reading.md).
System from figures vs decipherment on f. 6: about 137 figures for about 120 plaintext letters, so a syllable/word code, not a letter cipher. Group boundaries not recovered.

outcome.method_basis: In progress: the passages were deciphered at the time (interlinear decipherments). One passage (964 f. 6) transcribed and read from its decipherment; the rest not yet transcribed, so the method stays 'not solved' until they are, then 'read from existing decipherment'.
outcome.notes: Catalogue 598 asked whether decipherments are filed with the ciphers: they are written between the lines.

texts.label: George II to the Privy Council in Hanover, St James 6/17 Dec 1734
texts.summary: Approves what the Council wrote to Erffa in Vienna and von Haus: the Mecklenburg Reich contingent should not be raised by the King of Prussia. The ciphered clause is deciphered between the lines.
